meta_description: Palinedge Electrical provides expert electrical installation, repair and maintenance across Sheffield. Local, reliable, fast response times. Call now.
hero_subhead: Faulty electrics or no power? Palinedge Electrical responds fast across Sheffield, with same-day fixes for urgent faults.
services_subhead: From urgent fault-finding to new installations and rewires, we handle every electrical job with precision and care.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Power cuts, blown circuits, or dangerous faults? We diagnose and fix most problems the same day. Available 24/7 for serious emergencies.

services.title: Domestic Rewiring
services.desc: Old wiring causing concern? We replace outdated systems with modern safe installations, tested and certified for your peace of mind.

services.title: New Installations & Extensions
services.desc: Adding sockets, lights, or wiring a new room? We design layouts to suit your needs and complete work to the highest building standards.

services.title: Periodic Testing & Inspections
services.desc: Regular electrical safety checks protect your home and tenants. We issue detailed reports and highlight any risks before they become serious.

services.title: Boiler & Heating Controls
services.desc: Install, repair, or upgrade electrical components for your heating system. We ensure thermostats and controls work reliably all winter.

services.title: Fault-Finding & Diagnosis
services.desc: Flickering lights, tripping switches, or mystery outages? We trace electrical faults methodically and fix the root cause, not just the symptom.

about_pullquote: I built Palinedge because every home deserves safe, reliable electrics without the premium price tag.
about_para_1: Palinedge Electrical was founded on a simple idea: provide Sheffield families and businesses with honest, skilled electrical work at fair rates. Over 18 years, we've completed over 2,000 jobs across the city—from emergency repairs at midnight to full rewires in new builds. Every team member is NICEIC registered and carries full public liability cover, so you know you're in safe hands.
about_para_2: We've built our reputation by turning up on time, explaining the problem clearly, and charging what we quote—no hidden extras. Repeat customers make up most of our work, which says everything. We specialise in getting to the root of electrical faults rather than just patching them over, and we pride ourselves on leaving your home cleaner than we found it.

reviews.text: Our kitchen electrics were playing up—lights flickering, odd burning smell. Called Palinedge on a Wednesday morning, guy was here by 2pm. Found a dodgy junction box that could've been dangerous. Fixed it properly and didn't rip us off. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had the whole house rewired. The team were professional, tidy, and explained everything as they went. Finished on schedule and everything's been perfect since. Definitely recommend if you need electrical work done.
reviews.author: Lisa D.

reviews.text: Power tripped during a storm late evening. Rang Palinedge expecting an emergency call-out charge, but they came out, found a wet connection in the garage, dried it out, and tested everything. Fair price and honest advice. Top bloke.
reviews.author: Paul K.
